description: Ar bus - Landerneau-Daoulas, Transport is a dataset listed in data.bretagne.bzh open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Communauté de Communes du Pays de Landerneau-Daoulas. La Région Bretagne publie pour le compte de la Communauté d'agglomération du Pays de Landerneau-Daoulas le jeu de données de l'offre de transport théorique et temps réel de son réseau AR BUS. Pour plus d'informations rendez vous sur:. Coverage: Brittany. The portal files it under Transport - Mobilité. Its keywords are transport de voyageurs. The portal shows 1 records. The portal shows 2024-09-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODBL: https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/ (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-bretagne-bzh-portal.
